add_generic_args: add generic CLI arguments for convnet training and testing to an argparse parser
check_generic_args: validate parsed CLI arguments and create the checkpoint folder if it does not exist
get_parser: get a standard argparse parser preconfigured with Classy Vision training arguments
parse_train_arguments: parse and validate command-line arguments for a Classy Vision training job
review_opts_module: review the opts module functions for adding and validating Classy Vision CLI arguments
